{"path":"calc_co2.pqi","new_content":"SOLUTION 1
    temp 25
    pH 7.5
    units mg/L
    Ca 100
    Alkalinity 250 as CaCO3
END
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
USER_PUNCH
    -headings a_CO2
    10 PUNCH ACT("CO2")
END
"}
